name: Simple and Easy Corn Fritters

ingredients.name: neutral oil, such as vegetable, canola, or peanut oil

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, whisk together cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar. In a separate bowl combine milk and eggs then pour wet ingredients over dry ingredients and whisk to combine. Add melted butter and corn and mix well.

To a Dutch oven or wok, add oil until it measures 2-inches deep and heat to 350°F. Working in batches, drop corn fritter batter into hot oil one tablespoon at a time. Cook, agitating and turning frequently until golden brown and crisp on all sides and fritters are cooked through, about 4 minutes total. Remove fritters to a large plate lined with paper towels and season with salt. Return oil to 350°F and repeat with remaining batter. Serve immediately, garnished with powdered sugar or sliced scallions.

schema_metadata.keywords: corn, corn fritters, quick, Southern, Sunday Brunch

description: These easy corn fritters are crisp, fluffy, and ready in 25 minutes. Serve them savory with scallions or sweet with powdered sugar or syrup.
notes: Optional or for serving: Powdered sugar (optional); Sliced scallions (optional)
author: Sydney Oland
